name: Comic Con Northern Ireland
blurb: Monopoly Events' Northern Ireland pop culture convention at the Eikon Centre near Belfast, with film, TV and gaming guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage: '18th - 19th Sept, 2027 Eikon Centre, Lisburn'; JSON-LD on the page is stale (dated 2022) and was not used.

notes: Annual show (per the site's own 'annual shows' copy, unlike biannual sibling events Liverpool/Wales). The guests page shows only a single 'TBC' placeholder tile with no names - guests is 'none-yet'. 'In previous years' text namedrops Elijah Wood, Sean Astin, Ian Somerhalder, Michael Rooker and Paul Wesley, but that is marketing copy about past shows, not a confirmed 2027 lineup, so it was not picked. Organizer Monopoly Events confirmed by the shared Wix template/footer copyright and the seed note.
